recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-32543 unless the work group later changes ConceptMap.group.unmapped fixed-mode semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-32543 was a Published/Persuasive R5 Vocabulary change request asking what ConceptMap.group.unmapped.code means if ConceptMap.group.unmapped.mode is not 'fixed'. The approved resolution was to add constraints so unmapped.code and unmapped.display may only be valued when unmapped.mode = fixed.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies git commit 6fcced7147 as the application. That commit added cmd-8 to ConceptMap2: if mode is not 'fixed', code, display, and valueSet are not allowed. A later ConceptMap2-to-ConceptMap refactor preserved the same rule in the current source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists conceptmap=ConceptMap as an active resource and assigns conceptmap to the vocab work group, so source/conceptmap/structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml is in current build scope. Vocabulary WG minutes from 2021-06-23 also record FHIR-32543 as adding invariants for ConceptMap unmapped values. Quoted issue-key Zulip and Confluence full-text searches found no conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current ConceptMap StructureDefinition already has cmd-8 on ConceptMap.group.unmapped with FHIRPath `(mode != 'fixed') implies (code.empty() and display.empty() and valueSet.empty())`, and the affected child elements reference cmd-8.
